subject: Yellow mosaic patches on Boro paddy leaves in Comilla region

assignedExpert.name: Dr. Farhana Akter
assignedExpert.specialization: Rice Disease Management & Integrated Pest Control

messages.text: Hello doctor, my 35-day-old Boro seedlings are developing irregular pale-yellow mosaic mottling on young leaf tips. Stems look somewhat stunted. I took two field photos. Could you prescribe treatment?

Greetings Kamal. Based on the chlorotic leaf streaks and vein clearing in your photo, this is early Rice Tungro Virus (RTV) transmitted by Green Leafhoppers (GLH). Stop any additional urea top-dressing immediately as high nitrogen promotes leafhopper multiplication.
Understood. What insecticide and dosage should I spray immediately to protect the remaining 2 acres?

subject: Potato late blight prevention schedule before cold wave

messages.text: Due to heavy fog and cold weather in Bogura, my potato plants are showing dark water-soaked lesions on the tips of leaflets. Is Mancozeb 75% enough or should I use systemic fungicides?

Greetings! Once active water-soaked lesions appear, preventive contact fungicides like Mancozeb alone will not cure the infected tissue. Apply systemic combination: Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% (e.g. Ridomil Gold) at 2g per liter of clean water.
